The '''''Luxury''''', also known as '''''The Luxury''''', was a luxurious [[Starship/Legends|liner]] that was used during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
The ''Luxury'' was owned by the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Veer]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he hired it out to the [[Sentient Beings Opposing Violence]], who planned to hold a peace summit on board it, in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. However, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Raik Muun]] attacked the summit with [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and [[t'salak]]s. She was eventually defeated by the [[Heroes of Cularin]], although not before [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kirlocca]] had been killed. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was severely damaged by the battle and the [[Thaereian military]] sent over engineers to try and repair it.
